findings.title: WETHHook (src/WETHHook.sol#12-54) declares custom-accounting permissions: `beforeSwapReturnDelta` (bit 3)
findings.description: WETHHook (src/WETHHook.sol#12-54) declares custom-accounting permissions: `beforeSwapReturnDelta` (bit 3). dimensions.name: Complexity
dimensions.bracketLabel: Returns a delta and makes an external call in the swap path
evidence: hook-profile metrics: callbacksImplemented=2, callbacksDeclared=3, stateWritesInCallbacks=0, externalCallsInSwapPath=7, externalCallsInSwapPathThirdParty=1, internalFunctionsReachableFromCallbacks=13, usesReturnsDelta=true, hasOwnerOnlyFunctions=false

Scored 4 by rule `usesReturnsDelta && externalCallsInSwapPath >= 1`: A hook that both alters settled amounts and leaves the swap path mid-flight has two interacting flows to reason about, not one. (hookrisk’s interpretation; the framework publishes no brackets)
The hook implements callbacks with non-trivial structure. This establishes a floor only; the measured value comes from the hook-profile metrics when the engine profiled the target.

dimensions.name: Custom math
dimensions.bracketLabel: A custom curve or invariant function
evidence: Custom accounting implies a custom curve or non-standard settlement arithmetic.

dimensions.name: External dependencies
dimensions.bracketLabel: A dependency read inside the swap path, or more than one dependency
evidence: Scored 2 by rule `always` on weth (medium): The framework's 2 bracket verbatim: a dependency read inside the swap path. Unconditional, so a finding whose call kind the detector did not classify also scores 2 — the direction that does not understate risk. (hookrisk’s interpretation; the framework publishes no brackets)
An external call inside the swap path reopens the execution environment mid-swap.

dimensions.name: TVL potential
evidence: Declared in hookrisk.toml. hookrisk does not measure tvlPotential.

dimensions.name: Team maturity
dimensions.bracketLabel: Unproven: no prior production deployments, or deployments lacking audits and operational rigor; new, anonymous, or no public track record
evidence: Declared in hookrisk.toml. hookrisk does not measure teamMaturity.

dimensions.name: Upgradeability
evidence: Not measured: no detector for upgradeable-hook (needs blocksec, which did not run); selfdestruct requires blocksec, which did not run.

dimensions.name: Autonomous parameter updates
dimensions.bracketLabel: All parameters set by an explicit privileged call
evidence: No admin-surface findings, and every detector that could produce one ran.
Corroborated by the hook profile: no owner-only surface, and HS-03 found no unguarded mutator of callback-read state.

dimensions.name: Price impacting behavior
dimensions.bracketLabel: Returns a swap delta (custom curve or NoOp), or adjusts fees without a ceiling
evidence: A returns-delta permission lets the hook alter settled amounts, which is the framework’s definition of price-impacting behaviour.
